lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Heidi Volkov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Heidi is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d41: 🕯️ Heidi Volkov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Heidi kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Heidi's gone." Zintle looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Heidi." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Renee blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Fine Woodworking (Level 1). Joints that hold without nails: mortise, tenon, and the humble dovetail.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Heidi Volkov, 41 days. The mantle passes to Renee Fan.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Renee Fan, 22 — a carpenter. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Echo Location, Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Heidi — and Heidi is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Mason, Zintle, Guelor and 1 more speak for Renee — "Heidi trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Renee before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
